Thank you for your interest in pleno-dlp!

This project handles secret material (credentials, PII), so we use an
explicit trust model powered by [vouch](https://github.com/mitchellh/vouch).
New contributors must be vouched for by a maintainer before PRs or
issues are accepted.

**How to get vouched:** open a discussion or reach out to a maintainer.
Once a maintainer comments `vouch` on an issue you authored, you will
be added to the trusted contributor list automatically.
